benchmark.geometry_source: Saved synthetic CAD footing envelope; explicitly reviewed dimensions in metres; no capacity evidence.
benchmark.footprint_source: Saved CAD column envelope reviewed only as a hypothetical concentric loading patch, not a base plate or RC connection.
benchmark.load_source: Explicit synthetic concentric downward column load; footing self-weight deliberately excluded from this verification case.
benchmark.pressure_source: Explicit synthetic uniform NET upward pressure, independent of all bearing-capacity and soil-profile results.
benchmark.reference_source: Saved footing bottom and top Up references; pressure at bottom and hypothetical column patch at top.
benchmark.load_path_source: Reviewed hypothetical direct distributed column patch solely for synthetic demand verification. Actual steel-column/base-plate/concrete transfer remains unsupported.
benchmark.applicability: Symmetric square footing and square centered patch; prescribed uniform net upward pressure, zero eccentricity/shear/moments; no self-weight, uplift, capacity or code checks.

result.scope: Synthetic column-face bending demand only; no soil pressure imported from bearing resistance

inputs.geometry_source: Saved synthetic CAD footing envelope; explicitly reviewed dimensions in metres; no capacity evidence.
inputs.footprint_source: Saved CAD column envelope reviewed only as a hypothetical concentric loading patch, not a base plate or RC connection.
inputs.load_source: Explicit synthetic concentric downward column load; footing self-weight deliberately excluded from this verification case.
inputs.pressure_source: Explicit synthetic uniform NET upward pressure, independent of all bearing-capacity and soil-profile results.
inputs.reference_source: Saved footing bottom and top Up references; pressure at bottom and hypothetical column patch at top.
inputs.load_path_source: Reviewed hypothetical direct distributed column patch solely for synthetic demand verification. Actual steel-column/base-plate/concrete transfer remains unsupported.
inputs.applicability: Symmetric square footing and square centered patch; prescribed uniform net upward pressure, zero eccentricity/shear/moments; no self-weight, uplift, capacity or code checks.

computed.formula: a_EW=(B-cE)/2; a_NS=(L-cN)/2; for each full-width cut: w=q_net*b; V=w*a; M_face=w*a^2/2; per metre m=q_net*a^2/2; m(s)=q_net*(a-s)^2/2 from face toward free edge. q_net*B*L=N.
computed.sign_convention: ENU axes; upward pressure +Up. External face moment is r cross F: East -My, West +My, North +Mx, South -Mx. Report positive demand magnitudes; internal resisting cut moment is opposite. No capacity/sign-of-reinforcement verdict.
computed.reference_note: VDOT ASD manual section4.4.11.1.1: isolated footing as cantilever; column-face section; integrate forces on one side. Used solely to document the mechanics idealization, not compliance.
limitations: Demand only; no reinforcement area, effective depth or material strengths inferred
Orthogonal full-width cuts overlap in area: never sum their four upward forces as separate reactions or their magnitudes as one global moment
Prescribed uniform NET upward pressure with footing self-weight deliberately excluded from this synthetic equilibrium benchmark
No plate/shell FEA, cracking, stiffness, deflection, nonuniform reaction, uplift, eccentricity, shear or physical connection transfer
Actual steel-column/base-plate/RC-footing behavior remains unverified; the reviewed column envelope is only a hypothetical load patch
No reinforcement adequacy, one-way shear, punching, footing/soil safety or IS/US code checks
